Name: SpoolUp
Description: Star Citizen controls through SpoolUp: live key lights, press animations, dials and scenes, with SpoolUp's focus check. Fan project, not affiliated with Cloud Imperium Games.

com.xattribution.spoolup.key.Name: Deck Button
com.xattribution.spoolup.key.Tooltip: Presses a SpoolUp button through its focus check, with live lights.

com.xattribution.spoolup.dial.Name: Deck Dial
com.xattribution.spoolup.dial.Tooltip: One SpoolUp press per detent; push or touch for a third button.

com.xattribution.spoolup.scene.Name: Scene
com.xattribution.spoolup.scene.Tooltip: Goes to a scene page of the SpoolUp profile; tablets can follow.

com.xattribution.spoolup.theme.Name: Theme
com.xattribution.spoolup.theme.Tooltip: Draws every SpoolUp key and dial in a manufacturer theme.

com.xattribution.spoolup.talk.Name: Hold to Talk
com.xattribution.spoolup.talk.Tooltip: Hold to speak a SpoolUp voice command.

com.xattribution.spoolup.status.Name: Status
com.xattribution.spoolup.status.Tooltip: Shows the link to SpoolUp and its round trip.

com.xattribution.spoolup.lights.Name: Reset Lights
com.xattribution.spoolup.lights.Tooltip: Turns off every lit key. SpoolUp can't see the game, so lights only show what was pressed.
